25/S0.subgoal: Explain the context and goals of the 'Human Factors in XR' lecture by recapping previous concepts.

25/S1.subgoal: Describe how interaction and perceptual design work together to create an illusion of reality and enhance presence.

25/S2.subgoal: Describe the biological challenges and potential outcomes (like cybersickness) when humans use systems designed to fool their perception.

25/S3.subgoal: Define perceptual psychology and explain its importance in designing better XR systems.

25/S4.subgoal: Classify the human senses and describe the specific receptors and organs involved in each.

25/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
